claims.proposition: Historical epistemic events cannot be silently modified.
Current epistemic state can be independently reconstructed from historical events.
Evidence cannot silently migrate between claims.
Negative results remain preserved and cannot be silently deleted, suppressed, or replaced.
Qualification cannot flow backward and retroactively validate the evidence used to obtain that qualification.
AI confidence cannot independently authorize an epistemic transition.
Competing explanations cannot be silently suppressed.

rules: The verifier must not rely exclusively on the original local test harness or fixtures.
A failed verification is preserved as a finding; it is not repaired in-place.
Verification evidence is distinct from qualification and human ratification.
A source-hash mismatch aborts execution and prevents lineage merging.
